/* PayMapper.selectInvoicePaymentData : 정산서 결제정보조회 */ SELECT MAX(res.PAYMENT_STATUS) AS PAYMENT_STATUS
,SUM(inv.AMOUNT_TOTAL_LOC) AS AMOUNT_TOTAL_LOC ,MAX(inv.ACCOUNT_CODE) AS ACCOUNT_CODE ,MAX(ISNULL(ent.ENT_MAPPING_CODE, ent.ENT_CODE)) AS ENT_MAPPING_CODE ,MAX(ent.EASYPAY_MALL_ID) AS MALL_ID ,MAX(ent.EASYPAY_SECRET_KEY) AS SECRET_KEY ,ISNULL(DATEDIFF(DAY, MAX(res.EXPIRY_DATE), GETDATE()), 1) AS RE_REQ_CHECK ,( SELECT CASE WHEN bl.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' THEN CONCAT(bl.HBL_NO, '/', ISNULL(bl.CONSIGNEE_NAME, '')) ELSE CASE WHEN bl.SOLUTION = 'FMS' AND bl.BOUND IN('AIR', 'SEA') THEN CONCAT(bl.MBL_NO, '/', ISNULL(bl.CONSIGNEE_NAME, '')) ELSE bl.MBL_NO END END FROM TB_COM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_COM_OBL bl ON bl.OBL_JOB_NO = od.OBL_JOB_NO WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO = MAX(inv.OD_JOB_NO) ) AS GOODS_NAME FROM TB_SAS_INVOICE inv INNER JOIN exps_master.dbo.TB_SMS_ENTERPRISE ent ON ent.ENT_CODE = inv.ENT_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TOP 1 INVOICE_NO, PAYMENT_STATUS, APPROVAL_REQ_DATE, SHOP_TRANSACTION_ID, PG_CNO, EXPIRY_DATE, CASE WHEN PAYMENT_STATUS IN('R','S') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS SORT_SEQ FROM TB_SAS_PAY_RESULT WHERE INVOICE_NO = #{invoiceNo} ORDER BY SORT_SEQ ) res ON res.INVOICE_NO = inv.${invoiceNoField} WHERE inv.ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND inv.${invoiceNoField} = #{invoiceNo} GROUP BY inv.${invoiceNoField}

/* PayMapper.selectInvoiceList : 정산서번호 조회 */ SELECT CASE WHEN ISNULL(inv.INVOICE_NO_GROUP, '') = '' THEN inv.INVOICE_JOB_NO ELSE inv.INVOICE_NO_GROUP END AS SHOP_ORDER_NO ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(inv.INVOICE_NO_GROUP, '') = '' THEN 'INVOICE_JOB_NO' ELSE 'INVOICE_NO_GROUP' END AS INVOICE_NO_FIELD ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(inv.INVOICE_NO_GROUP, '') = '' THEN inv.INVOICE_NO ELSE inv.INVOICE_NO_GROUP END AS INVOICE_NO ,bl.SHIPPER_NAME ,CONCAT(ISNULL(bl.SHIPPER_ADDRESS, ''),ISNULL(bl.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_A, ''),ISNULL(bl.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_B, ''),ISNULL(bl.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_C, ''),ISNULL(bl.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_D, '')) AS SHIPPER_ADDRESS ,bl.CONSIGNEE_NAME ,CONCAT(ISNULL(bl.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS, ''),ISNULL(bl.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_A, ''),ISNULL(bl.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_B, ''),ISNULL(bl.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_C, ''),ISNULL(bl.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_D, '')) AS CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS ,bl.ITEM_NAME FROM TB_COM_OBL bl INNER JOIN TB_COM_OD od ON od.OBL_JOB_NO = bl.OBL_JOB_NO INNER JOIN TB_SAS_INVOICE inv ON inv.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO WHERE bl.HBL_NO = #{srchBlNo} OR bl.MBL_NO = #{srchBlNo}
